lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² at the 2016 census: each county's population over its area, averaged over the counties the hex covers. Large rural counties look evenly spread even where people live in a few towns. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Growth 2006–2016
lenses.description: Population change between the 2006 and 2016 censuses, per county, weighted by population where a hex covers several counties. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Where the county has no 2006 figure in Wikidata (most were split or redrawn since), the hex shows its province's growth instead.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.description: The province's 2016 GDP (SCI share × World Bank national GDP) divided by its 2016 population. Oil-producing provinces (Khuzestan, Bushehr, Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad) rank high because oil and gas output is counted where it is extracted. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Province-wide values: every hex of a province has the same colour.

lenses.name: Earthquakes
lenses.description: Earthquakes of magnitude 5.5 or more since 1900 (USGS catalogue) with an epicentre within 50 km of the hex centre. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Early-20th-century records are incomplete; zero means none recorded, not no risk.

lenses.name: Strongest quake
lenses.description: The largest magnitude among M5.5+ earthquakes since 1900 within 50 km of the hex centre (USGS catalogue). Blank where none was recorded.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by trees (ESA WorldCover 2021): the Hyrcanian forests on the Caspian slopes and the oak woodland of the Zagros. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is cropland (ESA WorldCover 2021). WorldCover has no separate pasture class; grazed steppe counts as grassland. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built-up (ESA WorldCover 2021): buildings, roads and other sealed surfaces. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
